2609.01294.title: Explore Before Committing: Hypothesis-Guided Search for Deep Research Agents
2609.01294.paper_summary: Deep-research agents answer complex questions by interacting with search and browsing tools, yet they often search along a single evolving trajectory. Our trajectory-level analysis reveals a common failure mode in which the agent may encounter an early search state with several plausible directions, but follow one direction before collecting enough comparative evidence. Once this happens, subsequent tool calls tend to reinforce the same path, increasing the chance of failure when the initial direction is misleading. We further find that successful trajectories reduce this risk through two behaviors: grounding vague exploration in concrete candidates and shifting directions when the current path is weak or incomplete. Based on these findings, we propose HypoSearch, which generates lightweight hypotheses as soft search hints, explores them through bounded independent branches, and compares branch-level evidence before commitment. Across four deep-research benchmarks and three backbone models, HypoSearch consistently outperforms single-trajectory search and standard parallel baselines, improving Qwen3.5-122B from 46.7 to 60.0 on BC-small while using fewer tool calls than five independent trajectories. A pilot supervised fine-tuning study further shows that these behavioral signals can curate compact training trajectories and reduce degradation from unfiltered data.
2609.01294.paper_summary_zh: 深度研究代理透過與搜索和瀏覽工具互動來回答複雜問題，但它們通常沿著單一的演變軌跡進行搜索。<lb/>我們的軌跡級分析揭示了一種常見的失敗模式，代理可能會遇到一個早期的搜索狀態，這個狀態有幾個合理的方向，但在收集足夠的比較證據之前就跟隨了一個方向。<lb/>一旦發生這種情況，隨後的工具調用往往會加強相同的路徑，當初始方向具有誤導性時，增加失敗的機會。<lb/>我們進一步發現，成功的軌跡通過兩種行為減少這種風險：將模糊的探索基於具體的候選者，並在當前路徑薄弱或不完整時改變方向。<lb/>基於這些發現，我們提出了HypoSearch，它生成輕量級的假設作為軟搜索提示，通過有限的獨立分支進行探索，並在承諾之前比較分支級證據。<lb/>在四個深度研究基準和三個主幹模型中，HypoSearch始終優於單一軌跡搜索和標準平行基線，將Qwen3.5-122B在BC-small上的表現從46.7提高到60.0，同時使用的工具調用少於五個獨立軌跡。<lb/>一項初步的監督微調研究進一步顯示，這些行為信號可以策劃緊湊的訓練軌跡，並減少來自未過濾數據的退化。
